card: One interface for several places an app keeps data.
title: Strata Storage beneath the app
intro: Strata Storage gives app makers one API over several storage layers, from browser storage to native storage.

sections.heading: What does its API cover?
sections.body: One interface sits over localStorage, IndexedDB, cookies and native storage.

sections.heading: Where can an app use it?
sections.body: It covers the web as well as iOS and Android.

sections.heading: How many dependencies does it add?
Where does Strata Storage fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell asks where a personal record should live and sync. Strata Storage addresses the app maker’s side: one interface over several storage layers.
